subject: Post-call: Cardwell security evidence & timeline (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cardwell.com>, Jena Park <jena.park@cardwell.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Cardwell security evidence & timeline (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)

Tom / Jena — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared list of asks and next steps. I’ve grouped items by priority so you can share with your security & procurement teams.

Key pain points you described:
- Regulatory/contract requirement: 7-year retention on select audit logs (payments origination scope).
- Need demonstrable chain-of-custody for logs (exportable CSVs or API access) for quarterly audits.
- Procurement requires SOC 2 Type II report and a recent external penetration-test summary; Cardwell’s PCI/third-party assessors will want evidence within RFP window.
- DPA negotiation points: data deletion/retention terms, subprocessors list, and permitted use clauses.

Goals in next 30 days:
1) Provide Cardwell with SOC 2 report and pen-test executive summary for initial security review.
2) Deliver sample audit log export covering a 30-day window and documentation for retention/TTL controls.
3) Share a DPA draft that addresses Cardwell’s 7-year retention and deletion exception process.
4) Confirm timeline to produce any additional evidence procurement requests will require.

What Redwood can provide (initial):
- SOC 2 Type II summary (attached) and link to full report under NDA.
- Pen-test exec summary (attached) covering 2026 assessment; full report available to named contacts under NDA.
- Audit log export sample (attached CSV) plus docs on retention config and export API.
- DPA draft (attached Word) with proposed language for retention and subprocessors.

Next steps / owners:
- Cardwell: confirm which security contacts should receive full reports under NDA and any additional evidence formats your assessor requires (Jena/Tom) — ACTION: Cardwell to confirm by Wed 3/17.
- Redwood (Mateo): I’ll share the attachments now and loop in Infosec to scope anything beyond what’s in the attached artifacts.
- Redwood (Marissa): I’ll include you on procurement communications and pricing/compliance timeline.

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary-2026.pdf, redwood-pen-test-exec-summary-2026.pdf, dpa-draft-cardwell.docx, audit-log-sample-30days.csv

If I missed anything from the call, flag it here. Otherwise I’ll follow up with the NDA template and the DocuSign link for the full SOC2 + pen-test exchange.

—
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.com

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@cardwell.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jena Park <jena.park@cardwell.com>, procurement@cardwell.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Cardwell security evidence & timeline (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)

Thanks Mateo — this is super helpful and captures the conversation. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Our primary ask: we need a SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and the high-level pen-test exec summary no later than March 26 to satisfy the RFP timeline. We will request the full reports after initial review if they look OK.
2) For retention: Cardwell’s legal needs a written description of how Redwood enforces retention policies, especially for the 7-year requirement. The sample CSV is great; would you confirm whether audit logs can be exported via API on-demand or only by support request?
3) DPA: We’ll redline the draft once procurement & legal have reviewed; our negotiator prefers tracked changes in Word.

ACTION: I’ll confirm the named contacts for NDA access by EOD Wed 3/17. Procurement (procurement@cardwell.com) will want a short note on estimated delivery dates for anything that requires additional approvals.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Tom

—
Tom Ellis
Head of Security Evaluations | Cardwell Finance
Tom.Ellis@cardwell.com | +1 (206) 555-0890
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Cardwell security evidence & timeline (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)

FYI — Cardwell (Tom/Jena) needs SOC2 + pen-test exec summary by 3/26 and confirmation about audit log export capability for their 7-year retention requirement. Procurement will redline the DPA; they prefer Word with tracked changes.

Can you help with the following?
- Neha: can you confirm whether we can provide on-demand API exports for audit logs and draft a 1-page retention controls description? Also please confirm the earliest date we can allow Cardwell (named e-mails) to access the full SOC2/pen-test reports under NDA.
- Marissa: please prepare a short note on typical procurement timelines and whether an interim artifact will be acceptable for the RFP. I’ll coordinate DocuSign/NDA.

I attached the artifacts we initially shared with the customer earlier (SOC2 summary + pen-test summary + sample CSV + DPA draft).

Thanks — Mateo

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Cardwell security evidence & timeline (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)

Matt / Marissa — quick plan below. I’ve attached a one-page retention-controls summary and a checklist for evidence delivery.

Summary of what we can provide by 3/26: 
- SOC 2 Type II: executive summary PDF (attached) + full report available to named contacts via secure link after NDA is signed.
- Pen-test: executive summary PDF (attached). Full report requires signed NDA and will be shared with Cardwell’s security lead.
- Audit logs: we support on-demand exports via our internal admin API for customers on Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted customers we provide daily export snapshots and a support-facilitated export for custom windows. 
  - For Cardwell’s 7-year requirement: recommend Dedicated or Private deployment; if they need hosted, we can propose a managed-retention addendum that stores exports for 7 years in a customer-controlled bucket.
- DPA redlines: legal can accept Word with tracked changes; Marissa please coordinate.

Attachments I added: retention-controls-summary-cardwell.pdf, evidence-delivery-checklist.csv

Estimated times: SOC2+pen summary (ready now — already attached), audit-log policy description (this morning), proposed managed-retention addendum language (draft by 3/19).

I’ll be available to join any technical call with Cardwell’s assessor if needed.

—
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
